This Bachelor of Applied Science in environmental management is unique to Lakeland College. If students already have an environmental credential, take our upskilling career-focused pathway.

If they have a diploma, they elevate their knowledge and skills.

If they have a degree, they will gain workforce-ready field skills.

They will spend their first 8 months at Lakeland building technical and field skills. Career-focused coursework and field labs run from September to April.

An 8-month practicum with an employer follows. A practicum coordinator helps them find a practicum host. Most run from May through December. Most are paid.

After their practicum, they complete the program with a capstone presentation in late winter. Capstone audiences include instructors, classmates, peers, and industry.

As a graduate they will have more than the applied degree, they will also have industry experience on their resumé.
